pyramiding_rule: Strictly prohibit adding to losing positions; multi-order entries within a 60-second window are capped at a maximum aggregate risk of $5.00.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Require institutional volume delta and ATR contraction confirmation prior to order placement to filter out high-impact news wicks.
profit_harvest_threshold: Trigger aggressive trailing stops or partial profit-taking as soon as floating profit hits +$15.00 to ensure wins run to the $15-$30+ target zone.
